title: 第十九章焚尸龙野第二十章我来了
content_zh:
“不可能吧，族长？”
“秦风怎么会有如此实力？”
“张风虽不是我们龙家族人，但也是栽培许久的强者，加上龙凤楼人多眼杂，秦风就算再怎么逆天，也做不到悄无声息击杀他吧？”
“而且，这家伙哪还有胆量敢回来做这些事情？”
“怕是连跑都来不及！！”
“是啊，族长大人！！”
“肯定是另有他人。”
“说不定，是其他家族的族长，趁着我们龙家这次损失惨重，故意这样干呢？？”
“.......”
几位龙家长老纷纷摇头说道。
显然，他们是不相信，秦风能够在如此情况下，敢回龙城不说，还在他们的眼皮子底下，杀了龙凤楼掌柜以及大长老之孙等。
甚至还能悄无声息的离去。
这绝对不是一般人能够做到的，最起码也要修为达到登天境的强者才行，而整个龙城里除了自家族长以外，就没有第二位登天境修士了。
所以只有一种可能性，那就是另外几座和龙城有着恩怨的家族势力强者，才会在这种情况下，做出这样的事情来。
其目的，就是想让龙家变得更加混乱。
虽然龙战也有点不太相信，秦风会在如此情况下，大胆归来，做出杀戮之事，可除了秦风以外，他还真想不到，谁有这个狗胆，做这种事情。
就在气氛越发压抑时。
突然，龙战等人身后响起了一道急促的声音。
“族长，有目击者活着！！”
说罢，便见一位龙家长老拎着见过秦风的店小二走了过来。

龙战回头看去，目光落在浑身颤抖的店小二身上道：“你见过行凶者？”
而此时的店小二，已经畏惧的说不出话来，就连裤裆之处，都有些许湿润。
“问你话呢，赶紧说！！”
“不想活了？”
龙家长老将店小二往地下一扔道。
“我真的什么都不知道啊。”
“我也不知道那家伙会干这种事情！！”
“大人，我是冤枉的。”
“我和凶手真没关系啊！！”
“求求大人，饶我一命！！”
“我上有老下有小，死不得啊.....呜呜！！”
店小二回过神来后，连忙跪在龙战脚边道。
见店小二这般模样，龙战眉头一簇，心中不由涌出了一股愤怒之火，眼看就要忍不住爆发时，二长老却急忙说道：“我们并不会杀你，也不会怪你，只是想让你说一下行凶者的外貌形态，好让我们去寻找此人。”
“你快回想一下，此贼子到底长什么样子？有何特征？”
content_en:
"Isn't it possible, clan leader?"
"How can Qin Feng have such strength?"
"Although Zhang Feng is not a member of our Dragon family, he is also a strong man who has been cultivated for a long time. In addition, the people in Longfeng Tower have many eyesight. Qin Feng can't kill him silently, no matter how hard he goes against the will, right?"
"Besides, how can this guy have the guts to come back and do these things?"
"I'm afraid I won't even have time to run!!"
"Yes, Lord Patriarch!!"
"There must be someone else."
"Maybe it's the patriarchs of other families who took advantage of our Long family's heavy losses and did this deliberately??"
"...."
Several elders from the Long family shook their heads and said.
Obviously, they did not believe that Qin Feng could dare to return to Longcheng under such circumstances and kill the shopkeeper of Longfeng Tower and the grandson of the great elder under their noses.
You can even leave quietly.
This is definitely not something that ordinary people can do. At the very least, it must be a strong person who has reached the Heaven Realm. And apart from the head of the family, there is no second Heaven Realm monk in the entire Dragon City.
Therefore, there is only one possibility, that is, several other powerful families who have grudges with Dragon City would do such a thing under such circumstances.
The purpose is to make the Long family even more chaotic.
Although Long Zhan didn't believe that Qin Feng would boldly come back and commit murder under such circumstances, he really couldn't imagine anyone other than Qin Feng who would have the guts to do such a thing.
Just when the atmosphere became more and more depressing.
Suddenly, a rapid voice sounded behind Long Zhan and others.
"Clan leader, there are witnesses alive!!"
After saying that, an elder from the Long family came over carrying the waiter who had met Qin Feng.
Long Zhan looked back, his eyes fell on the trembling waiter and said, "Have you seen the perpetrator?"
At this time, the waiter was so scared that he could not speak. Even his crotch was a little wet.
“I’m asking you something, tell me quickly!!”
"Don't want to live anymore?"
The veteran of the Long family threw the waiter to the ground.
"I really don't know anything."
"I didn't know that guy would do such a thing!!"
"My lord, I was wronged."
"I really have nothing to do with the murderer!!"
"Please, sir, spare my life!!"
"I have an old man above me and a young man below me. I can't die... Wuwu!!"
After the waiter came to his senses, he quickly knelt at Long Zhan's feet and said.
Seeing the waiter's appearance, Long Zhan frowned, and a burst of anger surged in his heart. Just when he was about to burst out, the second elder hurriedly said: "We won't kill you, and we won't blame you. We just want you to tell us the appearance of the perpetrator so that we can find him."
"Think about it quickly, what does this thief look like? What are his characteristics?"
